Rich already supports orange text through its named colours `orange1` and `orange3`. In markup, use `[orange1]your text[/]`, or pass `style="orange1"` to `console.print`. The style docs are at https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/style.rst

If you want orange as a default or as a new option in Rich itself, feature requests need approval in [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions) before an issue is opened. Please start there.
